# Version 4.150.0
> **Skia m150 and new APIs** · Released July 7, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.150.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.150.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.150.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.150.0 updates the engine to Skia m150 and expands image, color, and paint APIs. The release adds image-filter factories, overdraw visualization, and fast paint bounds while improving surface access and raster blur rendering. It also completes the v4 obsolete-API cleanup, so check the breaking changes before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Remaining pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now errors** — APIs still marked obsolete before v4 now produce compile errors, and obsolete enums are absent from the reference assembly. Replace affected calls with the supported alternatives identified by their prior obsolete messages. ([#4195](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4195))
- **.NET Interactive support was removed** — The deprecated Polyglot Notebooks integration is no longer included. Notebook users must reference SkiaSharp packages directly from a supported .NET Interactive environment. ([#4186](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4186))

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone 150** — Moves the bundled rendering engine to the Chrome m150 line and includes a follow-up round of upstream bug fixes. ([#4146](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4146), [#4190](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4190))

## API Surface

- **Image and color filters expanded** — Adds empty and crop image-filter factories plus an overdraw color filter for visualization workflows. ([#4228](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4228), [#4229](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4229), [#4227](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4227))
- **Fast paint bounds exposed** — Adds SKPaint.GetFastBounds() so callers can cheaply estimate drawing bounds for quick-reject culling. ([#4271](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4271))

## Bug Fixes

- **Small raster blurs render correctly** — Restores expected output for small-sigma raster blur effects affected by the faster raster pipeline. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4269](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4269))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Repeated surface canvas access is faster** — SKSurface now reuses its managed Canvas wrapper instead of recreating it on every property access. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4247](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4247))

## Security

- **HarfBuzz updated** — Refreshes the bundled text-shaping dependency to HarfBuzz 14.2.1. ([#4167](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4167))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
